notes: MG-only Australian Tier 1 BEV reconciliation checked 14 October 2026. Full exact current offering and separately evidenced residual-New versions are recorded. The two independent brand directories are narrower than the entire Australian market, so no whole-market C1 completion is asserted.

Manufacturer current model pages and configuration/offer material establish named offerings. Advertisements establish listed supply only; factory-order acceptance, physical stock and immediate delivery have not been verified.
CarExpert and CarsGuide include IM under the MG retail group. Existing catalogue identities remain MG and IM respectively; this queue mapping does not rebrand the catalogue.

MG currently offers MG4 EV, MG4 EV Urban, MGS5 EV, MGS6 EV and Cyberster. Earlier MG4 and MGS5 New advertisements are kept as separate exact model-year or specification cohorts; demos, sold cars and inaccessible/unidentified leads are not promoted to new supply.

Current MGS5 formal MY26 is established by the maker current page and the specifically dated July 2026 importer-quoted two-Essence update, including 150 kW / 450 km Essence 62. The linked brochure MY25 footer conflict is disclosed; every retained known fact and equipment answer has fresh review. Current Cyberster retains null formal model year because MY26 webpage and MY25 linked brochure cannot establish a distinct technical change.

MGU9 EV remains Coming Soon and Register Interest on both current official model and configuration pages. A selector price and generic hidden checkout skeleton do not prove an enabled current order offer; it is excluded from current on-sale coverage without importing provisional specifications.

ZS EV is absent from the current maker range and labelled discontinued/older by independent model lists. Full inherited residual leads are checked separately; a generated-today brochure or generic new-car-to-order template does not prove a current exact dealer-New unit. No universal claim of nationwide stock absence is made.
